newsitem.title: USA: OPTIONS -U.S. T-bond option vols skid into weekend.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS -U.S. T-bond option vols skid into weekend.

text.p: Implied volatilities for U.S. Treasury bond futures-options slid Thursday as time decay before the long holiday weekend and the prospect of a light economic calendar next week overshadowed the futures' rally.
"They got whacked," one T-bond futures-options floor broker said of volatilities.
"Vols got absolutely annihilated," said another broker. "August is just gone. August is just cooked."
The at-the-money August options, with only 10 days to expiration, slumped by some 1.5 percentage points to about 6.3 percent.
The September 112/114 T-bond strangle showed a smaller decline to about 7.6 percent vol, they added.

"It's a long weekend. You don't have anything coming out (next week)," said the first broker. "Even during the big (futures) rally...there was no fear. The risk/reward ratio wasn't large enough for owning something."
"If you had them on in the last day, the gamma may have made you break even," said the second broker. "But there's no reason to own volatility."
"We're going to come in here on Monday at seven to eight percent (for September)," said a third floor broker.

Traders saw scattered activity in options on Thursday. They said some call holders, especially in August, took profits, although trade had calmed shortly after the initial futures rally sparked by the soft June U.S. jobs figures.

The second broker also noted some fairly brisk early over-the-counter activity, apparently speculative, in the August 113, 114 and 115 calls. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750)) E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
